fact: WHO Gabon's 2025 annual report states that, following the national DHIS2 deployment of 2024, 25 DHIS2 experts, 16 military health data managers, 5 system administrators from ANINF and the Ministry of Health and more than 30 logisticians were trained in 2025, and gives the reporting completeness rate as 35% in 2024 and 40% in 2025.
title: Rapport Annuel Gabon 2025
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau du Gabon
